name: Cross-strait Cubing Exchange 2016

venue.name: Guangzhou Nanwu Secondary School
venue.address: No. 81 Xingyuan Street, Jiangnanxi Road, Haizhu District

information: The 3rd Cross-straiting Cubing Competition is coming! The competitors are limited to 220 competitors. A prepayment is necessary to Chinese competitors for the registration. For oversea competitors, registration fees are paid by cash at the venue.
